functions.notes: Only a 2-instruction swap remains in the join block after the 0x25/0x33 message arms: the ROM loads the data_ov004_021707d8 pool address before mov r1,#1 and then stores msg->status (str) before b0 (strb). Writing b0=1 before msg->status=1 gets the ldr first but then strb comes first (SCHED 6), which points to the ROM having no alias edge between the two stores. These were inert: chained assignment both ways, a local or inline pointer to the flags, an inline setter, bool b0, true-size and oversized struct, swapping if/else polarity, duplicating the tail into both arms. The same pattern in the 0xf8 and 0x1a4 blocks matches with mov first. The source has one raw read: count at res->unknown_4490+4 (GameResources 0x4494).
